description: This source file defines a RestaurantProfile data class and a RestaurantProvider class for managing restaurant data and operational logic in a Flutter app.

classes.name: RestaurantProfile
classes.description: Data class representing the restaurant's profile information, including name, story, contact details, address, operating hours, and Instagram handle.

classes.name: RestaurantProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier class that manages the state of the restaurant profile, including loading, and provides utility methods to check if the restaurant is open and to format today's operating hours.

methods.name: loadProfile
methods.description: Asynchronously loads or resets the restaurant profile; currently resets to a seeded profile.

methods.name: get isOpenNow
methods.description: Returns true if the current time is within the restaurant's operating hours for today.

methods.name: todayHoursFormatted
methods.description: Returns a formatted string of today's operating hours or 'Closed' if not available.

methods.name: _seedProfile
methods.description: Creates and returns a default RestaurantProfile instance with hardcoded data.
